d: A PlayStation Vita port of Silent Hill 3 based on the Windows PC version, featuring PS2 improvements, enhanced controls, widescreen support and more.
ld:
Silent Hill 3 Enhanced Edition brings the Windows PC version of Silent Hill 3 to the PlayStation Vita through static recompilation.

The project aims to restore features and details from the original PlayStation 2 version while adapting the experience to the Vita hardware.

Features:

30 FPS gameplay.

16:9 widescreen support.

PS2 sound pitch restored.

Improved puzzle cursor adapted for PS Vita controls.

Precompiled shaders and background shader compilation to reduce shader-related freezes.

Three controller layouts: PS Vita, PS2 rear touchpad and PS2 front touchscreen.

New controls configuration screen with translations.

Extra Options and improved options navigation.

Restored Silent Hill 2 easter egg references.

Improved loading and preparation screens.

Updated LiveArea artwork.


Requirements:

PlayStation Vita with compatible custom firmware.

libshacccg.suprx.

Original Windows PC copy of Silent Hill 3.

sh3prep to prepare the required game data.


Installation:

Install the VPK using VitaShell. Prepare the game data using sh3prep and follow the installation instructions in the project documentation.

The game data must be placed in:

ux0:data/sh3/
